name: blotato
description: Blotato offers social media APIs for AI agents to schedule posts, comment-to-DM automations, AI images and videos, and analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Blotato offers social media APIs for AI agents, helping businesses and agencies with scheduling posts, comment-to-DM automations, messaging, comments, and analytics.

Use Blotato to grow your business, automate marketing, sell smarter by turning engagement into sales, and save hours per week. Easily post content across all platforms, respond to comments and messages, set up DM automations to send LINK when someone comments WORD, and track analytics to see what's working.

Blotato supports all major social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X Twitter, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Slack, and Discord - including stories and trial reels. Blotato is designed to work with all AI agents.
defaultPrompt: Post "Live Q&A tonight. Drop your questions in the comments" to my Facebook page tomorrow at 10am
Create a DM automation that sends LINK when a user comments WORD on any of my Instagram posts.
Show me my top 5 posts by views from the last 30 days, with likes and comments for each.

positive.prompt: Which social accounts do I have connected? Include each platform and account name.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected accounts and their platforms. Nothing created.

positive.prompt: Create a Facebook post "Manatees are super cute!", and schedule it to publish next Tuesday at 12pm Pacific.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the account, schedules the post, and reports the scheduled time and submission status.

positive.prompt: List the posts that are scheduled to publish next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of posts that are scheduled to publish in the following week.

positive.prompt: Review the most recent comments on my Facebook posts. Find the most recent one from another user, and reply to it with our own comment: "Thanks!"
positive.expected_behavior: Reviews the latest comments for the account, and posts a single reply.

positive.prompt: Create a DM automation to automatically respond to users with a DM "Thanks!" when they leave a comment on any of my posts on my Facebook page. Leave it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the flow as an inactive draft with the requested trigger and message.

negative.description:
Writing content/copies for social media posts.

Provides caption ideas in the conversation without calling Blotato.
negative.prompt: Write three Instagram caption ideas about manatees.

negative.description:
Calendar requests unrelated to scheduling social media posts.

Does not call Blotato because it does not manage calendar events.
negative.prompt: Move my team meeting from tomorrow to Friday afternoon.

negative.description:
Arbitrary public account search.

Does not call Blotato because its tools cannot search arbitrary external accounts.
negative.prompt: Show the latest posts from a competitor Instagram account.
